mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT user_id FROM answer_record WHERE result = 1 UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM interview_turn WHERE status = 2 AND result = 1 ) correct_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS answer_date, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_count FROM ( SELECT user_id, result, create_time FROM answer_record UNION ALL SELECT user_id, result, answered_time AS create_time FROM interview_turn WHERE status = 2 ) learning_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY answer_date ASC

SELECT DISTINCT DATE(create_time) FROM ( SELECT user_id, result, create_time FROM answer_record UNION ALL SELECT user_id, result, answered_time AS create_time FROM interview_turn WHERE status = 2 ) learning_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND result = 1 ORDER BY DATE(create_time) DESC
